programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

Learning George's purpose, Samantha declares she is perfectly happy married to Darrin. programme.desc: Mini land-bound oceans, lakes are a treasure trove of aquatic wonders. Lakes make up just 3% of the Earth's surface, but they hold 180,000 square kilometres of fresh water. From the shoreline to their depths are unique habitats teaming with life, home to everything from birds and bugs to frogs and fish. They can be anything from sanctuary from land predators and temperature regulators to bountiful food sources and pit-stops for migrating birdlife. Take a deep breath and dive into the magical world of lakes!

programme.title: Cheetah: Beating the Odds

The cheetah will have to learn the hunting skills their mother has perfected. Once they've learnt the ropes, they'll make their own way across the plains, establishing territory and having cubs of their own.

programme.title: Destination Wild: India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: Over 196 bridges and through 55 tunnels, the Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy. Powerful forces of nature make the railyway line a dangerous route over the Grisons Alps to this day. The film accompanies the Bernina Express in winter over the highest rail route across the Alps.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Ferrocarril del Sur, one of the highest train routes on earth, runs right through the mountains of Peru. To this day, it is considered a miracle in the world of railways. The rails not only lead to the famous ruined city of Machu Picchu but connect the ancient Inca capital of Cusco with Puno on the shores of Lake Titicaca and the gleaming white city of Arequipa. A train journey with the Andes Explorer through a grandiose landscape and an undeveloped and inaccessible area.

programme.title: mareTV: Estonia's Enchanted Islands
programme.desc: Kihnu is one of 19 inhabited Estonian islands. When the women there ride motorcycles in colourful skirts, it is summer. Thanks to its remoteness, charming traditions have been preserved here. More than 2,000 islands belong to Estonia, none is like the other, each with its own character. Most of them were military restricted areas during the Soviet Union. Of all things, the strict shielding had its good points: beach, forest, juniper groves, they still characterise the landscape of Estonia's enchanted islands. Elly Karjam is a "multi-jobber": lighthouse keeper, ice-cream producer and contract knitter for the famous Kihnu sweaters. Summer is high season for her: She is expecting guests from the USA, who had their ancestors on Kihnu. Birches have to be cut for the so-called viht. This bunch of birch branches is an important accessory for the traditional sauna at midsummer. And the motorcycles in the shed are to be refloated.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: In honour of the Archangel Michael, thousands of medieval Christians set off on pilgrimages to the famous mountain monastery of the Mont-Saint-Michel in the Atlantic Ocean. Today it continues to enchant millions of visitors each year. But the pilgrimage route from Rouen to the mountain abbey seems to have been forgotten: it leads through the depths of Normandy into rural France. Modern pilgrims can expect a fascinating voyage of discovery along historic paths that will allow them to discover not only the original character of the country and its inhabitants, but also themselves.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: For centuries, pilgrims have set off on the Via Francigena in the hopes of reaching the tombs of the apostles Peter and Paul in Rome. The ancient pilgrimage route leads through the imposing Alps to the Great St Bernard Pass and from there cross-country through Italy: along the Aosta Valley and the endless rice fields of the Po Valley, over the mountains of the Apennines, and the rolling hills of Tuscany to Lazio – en route, modern pilgrims discover Italy's majestic and diverse landscapes, as well as traces of bygone eras. Along the way, they meet people who share with them their enthusiasm for the country and the tradition of pilgrimage.

The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programme.desc: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.desc: In this special conversation with The Lallantop's Kuldeep Mishra, authors Purabi Shridhar and Sanghita Singh discuss their book The Prime Minister's Table—a unique exploration of the food, kitchens and personal dining habits of India's Prime Ministers. From Jawaharlal Nehru to Narendra Modi, the book reveals the lesser-known human side of India's most powerful leaders through recipes, personal anecdotes and stories from their kitchens .

programme.title: LT Insider
programme.desc: In this episode of LT Insider, rapper Paradox opens up about MTV Hustle, Badshah, Honey Singh, Mafia Mundeer and the changing culture of Indian rap. He also talks about profanity, gun culture, rap terminology and Tanishk Bagchi's remake songs.

programme.title: Ghoom Ghaam
programme.desc: Ghoom Gham | In this episode, we take you inside Kanpur's famous leather industry and show how raw hide is transformed into finished leather belts and other products. We also explore the industry's export market and ground realities.

programme.title: Tarikh
programme.desc: How did reservation in India begin, and what role did Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj play in shaping Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's journey? This episode traces the history of reservation, from Shahu Maharaj's 1902 policy to the Poona Pact and Constituent Assembly debates.

programme.title: Netanagri
programme.desc: Lallantop's Siddhant Mohan conducted a nationwide survey to understand the current political mood ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly Elections. Who is leading in UP, and where do Rahul Gandhi and Kejriwal stand in the PM race?

programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: Nepal's flood death toll nears 1,000, with mass cremations underway and thousands still trapped in hydropower projects. In India, an FIR against Rahul Gandhi over the Haldwani 'purification' row has sparked protests, and Delhi's draft voter list drops 47.7 lakh names.

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: In today's Duniyadari, we discuss the meeting of PM Narendra Modi, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping at the SCO Summit amid changing global geopolitics. We also look at the Iran-US conflict, tensions over the Strait of Hormuz and India's diplomatic challenges.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: LIC Housing Finance, along with Canara Bank and Union Bank of India, has moved NCLAT against the NCLT-approved repayment plan for Subhash Chandra, which proposes paying just ₹6.25 crore against admitted creditor claims of ₹22,000 crore . The dissenting lenders have also alleged that five entities linked to Chandra's family controlled 61.78% of the voting share and helped push through the plan .

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: The murder of Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan in Shamli has triggered a political war over the Jat vote in western UP, with Akhilesh Yadav questioning the police encounter and Jayant Chaudhary visiting the family . The BJP has defended the action, accusing the SP of shielding criminals .

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: Can a growing waistline increase your cancer risk? We discuss the link between belly fat, visceral fat, and obesity-related cancers—plus brain health tips for your 30s and whether gut microbiome tests are actually worth it.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Akhilesh Yadav has announced booth-level campaigning from September 1, intensifying the political battle ahead of the 2027 UP elections. The episode also covers the closure of 26,000 schools, the AI-generated video controversy involving Yogi Adityanath, and the Ankit Baliyan murder case.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: Salman Khan's 'Karna' is set to go on floors next year, while Yash's 'Toxic' faces legal trouble despite earning ₹285 crore worldwide . We also cover Tom Hanks' 'The Comeback', Tom Cruise's 'Days of Thunder 2', and 'Mirzapur: The Movie' getting an A certificate with cuts.

programme.title: samosa Critics
programme.desc: Kareena Kapoor Khan and Prithviraj Sukumaran face off in Meghna Gulzar's Daayra, a crime thriller based on true events that questions justice, accountability, and the limits of the law. Does Kareena's intense performance give us another memorable cop character? Watch our trailer breakdown.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: Pakistan's batting struggles continued at Lord's as they crashed to a 194-run defeat against England, conceding the series 2-0. Ollie Robinson was the star with match figures of 8/35, while Saud Shakeel's fighting 97 was the only resistance in a target of 389.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.8
programme.desc: Mistaking it for Gwanghae's test, Jeongi sneaks into the Bunwon storeroom to choose pottery, only to be caught red-handed by Gangcheon. While confined, she finally realizes that the man she believed to be Gwanghae was actually someone else. As Jeongi tearfully confesses all the wrongs she has committed against him, Gwanghae listens with a quiet smile.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.9
programme.desc: When Jeongi vows to step forward to clear Gwanghae's name, Taedo grows increasingly frustrated. Fearing that his own fate may once again bring injustice upon innocent people, Gwanghae sends Jeongi away. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong urges Jeongi to finally let go of Taedo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.10
programme.desc: After discovering that Jeongi is a woman, Gwanghae urges her to flee at once. Instead, Jeongi asks for just ten days—enough time to complete the celadon teacups for Yukdo. Hearing rumors that Jeongi and Gwanghae share more than a simple connection, Imhae devises a scheme and locks the two of them together in a single room.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.11
programme.desc: Gwanghae orders Gangcheon to acknowledge Jeongi's achievements and reinstate her at the Bunwon workshop. Soon after, he learns from Hwa-ryeong that Jeongi has already left with Taedo—and discovers the shocking truth that the two are not actually biological siblings. When Yukdo's life is placed in danger, Gangcheon reveals to King Seonjo and the visiting envoy that it was Jeongi who crafted the teacups. As Taedo prepares to confess his feelings to Jeongi, Gwanghae suddenly appears…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.12
programme.desc: While Gwanghae meets with the envoy, Taedo rescues Jeongi from the warehouse where she has been locked away. Watching Jeongi and Taedo walk off together, Gwanghae is flooded with memories from his past. Taedo warns Jeongi that if she chooses not to be entangled with Gwanghae any longer, she must never allow her true identity as “Jeongi” to be revealed. Back at the Bunwon, Jeongi begins learning the potter's wheel under Yukdo's guidance…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.13
programme.desc: Consumed by anger, Gwanghae coldly tells Jeongi that she is no longer the person he once knew—and that she has nothing to do with him anymore. Left in tears as she gazes at the pottery she has made, Jeongi vows to earn Gwanghae's forgiveness. Meanwhile, in front of everyone at the Bunwon, Gangcheon orders that Euldam's vessels be destroyed…

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Way Back Home

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Parikrama

programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Kang's Kitchen 3 EP1
programme.desc: Kyuhyun faces overwhelming orders on his first day at the revamped restaurant, 'Kang's Kitchen'!

programme.title: Europe Outside Your Tent: Norway EP1
programme.desc: The glorious comeback of the four men who shined in "Europe Outside Your Tent"!

programme.title: time2Rlx Wildlife
programme.desc: Explore Botswana's wild landscapes, witnessing lions, giraffes, elephants, and vibrant birdlife in Chobe National Park, and experience thrilling hunts and the beauty of Africa's nature.

programme.title: time2Rlx Landscape
programme.desc: Fly over Norway's stunning landscapes, from the winding Atlantic Ocean Road to the snow-covered fjords. Experience the beauty of Bud Village and the famous Trollstigen, with calming music and the pure sounds of nature enhancing the tranquil journey.

programme.title: time2Rlx Night Sky
programme.desc: The starry sky offers a rare moment of peace in our busy world. Picture yourself atop a hill, mesmerized by the Milky Way and the soothing sounds of nature under the vast night sky.

programme.title: time2Rlx Nature Walks
programme.desc: Explore the lush jungle paths of Hawaii's Tropical Botanical Garden, surrounded by vibrant tropical plants, birdsong, and the soothing sound of forest streams. A perfect retreat for nature lovers.

programme.title: Dalle 5 Alle 7
programme.desc: Un aspirante romanziere comincia una relazione con una donna, anche se c'è solo un problema: la donna è sposata e la coppia può incontrarsi solo tra le 5 e le 7 ogni sera.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: Il giro del Mondo in 80 Giorni
programme.desc: Phileass Frogg e Passepartout sono rispettivamente una rana e una scimmia marmosetta. Scommettono con gli abitanti del villaggio che riusciranno a fare il giro del mondo in 80 giorni.

programme.title: Jack Il Ciclone
programme.desc: Jack è tornato e stavolta è alle prese congli half-pipe delle cime innevate del Colorado. Jack fa squadra con due fratelli e diventa presto un campione dello snowboard! Le sue abilità lo portano dove nessuno scimpanzé era stato prima.

programme.title: Jumbo
programme.desc: Jumbo è un elefante che vive su un'isola, è molto intelligente e riesce a sillabare qualsiasi parola. Ogni anno si indice una gara dove partecipano numerosi animali, ciascun partecipante deve sillabare una parola senza sbagliare.

programme.title: Bogus
programme.desc: Quando Albert va a vivere con Harriet Franklin, l'amica d'infanzia ferocemente indipendente di sua madre, non arriva da solo.

programme.title: Venere in pelliccia – Le malizie di Venere
programme.desc: Savier, ricchissimo e annoiato giovanotto tedesco, nel corso di una vacanza presso il lago di Ginevra s'innamora perdutamente di Wanda Fontanati, una ragazza spregiudicata e pressoché ninfomane. Sviluppa così una relazione intensa con lei, ma senza pretendere l'esclusiva del suo corpo, anzi sottoponendosi a ripetute umiliazioni, schiavo d'amore della sua musa dominatrice.

programme.title: L'insegnante di violoncello
programme.desc: Arriva l'estate e Mario, giovane di buona famiglia, rifugge la noia prendendo lezioni di violoncello. A tenere il corso è la splendida e giunonica insegnante Margherita che con il suo fascino procace non tarda a turbare i sogni del volenteroso allievo.

programme.title: Action
programme.desc: Bruno Martel è un attore fallito, ridottosi a girare piccoli ruoli in film di serie b, che viene ripetutamente tradito dalla moglie Ann, una fotomodella. L'uomo decide allora di buttarsi nel cinema porno, ma l'ambiente lo disgusta a tal punto da farlo fuggire insieme ad Ofelia, una sua giovane collega di set.

programme.title: Voglia di donna
programme.desc: Tre episodi dove le coppie sono protagoniste: un gelataio innamorato di una donna focosa, una ragazza che tradisce il fidanzato e due sposini che si videoregistrano.

programme.title: Narcos: gli innocenti
programme.desc: In Colombia, i giovani sicari al servizio dei cartelli della droga rischiano di essere eliminati dai propri capi dopo aver appreso informazioni riservate. Jesús, Diego e Miguel sono tra questi ragazzi nel mirino.

programme.title: L'arte di arrangiarsi
programme.desc: Il celebre Alberto Sordi in una divertentissima commedia. Rosario Scimoni, detto Sasà, è una persona opportunista e senza scrupoli, nipote del sindaco di Catania, sempre pronto a schierarsi con chiunque possa aiutarlo. Passa dal socialismo al fascismo, cambiando fede politica con la stessa facilità con cui cambia le donne. Prova addirittura a fondare un proprio partito. Diretto da Luigi Zampa.

programme.title: Il Federale
programme.desc: Nel 1944 un graduato delle brigate nere è incaricato di catturare un professore antifascista e di condurlo dall'Abruzzo a Roma. Il viaggio di ritorno si rivela complicato, tra incidenti, bombardamenti, agguati partigiani e incursioni tedesche.

programme.title: Questa volta parliamo di uomini
programme.desc: Grande classico del cinema italiano diretto dal Premio Oscar Lina Wertmüller e interpretato da personalità di spicco tra cui Nino Manfredi, Luciana Paluzzi e Margaret Lee. Il film, suddiviso in quattro episodi, vede come protagonisti un industriale in crisi finanziaria, un lanciatore di coltelli disperato, un contadino che disprezza la propria moglie e una donna esasperata dal marito.

programme.title: La bambolona
programme.desc: Un avvocato, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, perde la testa per una ragazza che apparentemente sembra ingenua e sprovveduta. In realtà, la giovane donna sfrutta astutamente la sua bellezza per abbindolare il suo maturo spasimante.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Aida
programme.desc: Il giovane Radames, condottiero delle truppe egiziane e trionfatore sugli Etiopi nella guerra per il possesso dell`alta valle del Nilo, ottiene dal faraone la liberazione della bellissima schiava Aida, di cui è innamorato, e di suo padre, Amonasro, re degli etiopi. Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: You Cannot Kill David Arquette
programme.desc: Definito come l'uomo più odiato del wrestling, l'attore David Arquette tenta un difficile ritorno allo sport che ha bloccato la sua promettente carriera a Hollywood. Pericolosamente determinato a riscattare la sua reputazione e a recuperare il rispetto per se stesso, Arquette non si fermerà davanti a nulla per guadagnarsi un posto nel wrestling professionistico.

programme.title: Noi siamo la marea
programme.desc: Quindici anni fa l'oceano è sparito dalla costa di Windholm, in Germania. E così pure i bambini del luogo. Il giovane fisico Micha vorrebbe condurre studi approfonditi su questo fenomeno inspiegabile, ma necessiterebbe della borsa di studio che gli è stata negata. Decide comunque di partire, accompagnato da Jana, ex collega e figlia del rettore dell'università in cui lavora. Ad attendere i due, un mistero da svelare e i fantasmi del loro passato in comune.

programme.title: Un padre, una figlia
programme.desc: Romeo ha cresciuto con amore la figlia Eliza, sperando in un futuro brillante per lei all'estero. Quando Eliza vince una borsa di studio, la sua vita sembra finalmente prendere il volo. Ma l'aggressione che subisce il giorno prima dell'esame di ammissione in Regno Unito metterà a dura prova le sue scelte e i valori che ha sempre trasmesso alla figlia.

programme.title: L'età giovane
programme.desc: Ahmed ha 13 anni ed è entrato nella spirale dell'integralismo musulmano grazie all'indottrinamento di un imam che, tra le altre cose, gli ripete che la sua insegnante di lingua araba, anch'essa musulmana, è un'apostata. Ahmed che venera un cugino martire dell'Islam, decide allora di procedere autonomamente e di passare all'azione nei suoi confronti.

programme.title: UN AMORE MALATO
programme.desc: Una fotografa sviluppa un'ossessione che mette a rischio relazioni e sicurezza personale.

programme.title: BASTA DIRE Sì
programme.desc: La vita di Michelle è in declino: è stata licenziata e mollata lo stesso giorno. La sua migliore amica Sara, la convince a partecipare a un ritiro benessere dove deve solo "dire di sì" . Lì, però, col suo mentore Josh nasce una chimica inaspettata…

programme.title: UN AMORE MALATO
programme.desc: Una fotografa sviluppa un'ossessione che mette a rischio relazioni e sicurezza personale.

programme.title: LA DOPPIA VITA DI MIO MARITO
programme.desc: Una donna scopre che il marito nasconde una vita parallela e decide di indagare, ritrovandosi coinvolta in una spirale di bugie e pericolo.

programme.title: L'AMORE NON SI IMPARA
programme.desc: La PR Elizabeth ha una nuova sfida da affrontare: occuparsi di sua nipote Ruby e salvare la scuola. Cosa guadagna? Jamie, ex broker e maestro della scuola, si trasforma in babysitter

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: La sera di tutti i giorni
programme.desc: La sera di tutti i giorni, il film diretto da Felix Tissi, racconta storie slegate ma unite dal tema della vecchiaia, attraverso i temi dell'amore e della morte.

programme.title: Queen of the desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell, personaggio realmente esistito è una donna inglese dalla vita ricca e avventurosa che, all'alba del XX secolo, fu viaggiatrice, scrittrice, archeologa, esploratrice, cartografa, agente segreto e diplomatica per conto dell'Impero Britannico.

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: Lo sciacallo: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Louis non riesce a trovare lavoro. Un giorno assiste per caso a un incidente stradale e ha un'illuminazione: si procura una videocamera e da quel momento passa le notti correndo sui luoghi delle emergenze, per riprendere le scene più cruente e vendere il materiale ai network televisivi.

programme.title: Undisputed II: Last Man Standing
programme.desc: Il campione dei pesi massimi della boxe George Chambers, si trova in Russia per disputare incontri di pugilato, quando viene nuovamente incastrato per possesso illecito di droga. Da qui ricominciano le sue avventure con gli incontri clandestini disputati nel carcere di massima sicurezza.

programme.title: Knight of cups
programme.desc: Il padre era solito leggere al figlio Rick (Christian Bale), ancora ragazzino, questa storia: “C'era una volta un giovane principe che il padre inviò in Egitto a cercare una perla. Ma, quando il principe arrivò, la gente gli porse una coppa.

programme.title: Quel momento imbarazzante
programme.desc: Tre migliori amici si fanno una promessa: quella di restare tutti single. Hanno infatti timore che le relazioni serie possano annullare le loro personalità e far cambiare il loro rapporto di amicizia. Nel momento in cui meno se lo aspettano però tre ragazze gli faranno cambiare idea.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Woman wanted
programme.desc: Emma viene assunta come governante nella casa di Richard, vedovo, e di suo figlio Wendell, che sta attraversando un brutto periodo dopo la morte della madre. Tra i due uomini regna una grande tensione e, quando sia padre che figlio finiscono per innamorarsi di Emma, il loro rapporto verrà messo ancora di più a dura prova.

programme.title: Sotto il segno dell'amore
programme.desc: Kelsey lavora per una rivista e per scrivere un articolo sulla visione scettica dell'amore e degli oroscopi collabora con Carter, un maestro dell'astrologia. Nonostante provengano da mondi opposti, i due scoprono che l'amore può davvero essere scritto nelle stelle.

programme.title: Un pizzico d'amore
programme.desc: Un esperto culinario ha il compito di elevare la personalità del marchio di un canale alimentare. Mentre le loro personalità crollano, iniziano a rendersi conto che il contrasto può essere buono in amore come lo è nel cibo.

programme.title: La meta del cuore
programme.desc: Il suo sogno è sempre stato quello di organizzare eventi, ecco perché quando i suoi migliori amici decidono di sposarsi, Madison si offre di occuparsi lei di tutto. Sceglie come location una piccola isola sperduta della Nuova Zelanda dove l'affascinante David possiede un vigneto molto suggestivo e si offre di aiutarla nei preparativi.

programme.title: Il ragazzo dei miei sogni
programme.desc: Abby, orientata alla carriera, accetta di aiutare il suo capo impegnato a trovare l'uomo dei suoi sogni, ma incontra un dilemma quando inizia a innamorarsi dello stesso uomo con cui il suo capo approva gli appuntamenti.

programme.title: Nuove radici
programme.desc: La moglie e madre Amish, Annie, affronta una crisi quando suo marito lascia la comunità Amish per vivere tra gli americani normali, o gli inglesi come li chiamano gli Amish. Ma la situazione diventa ancora più grave quando suo marito torna, cercando la custodia del loro figlio ed è disposto a uccidere per raggiungere il suo obiettivo…

programme.title: Fama da assassino
programme.desc: Un'esperta di relazioni pubbliche si vanta del suo basso profilo e della sua reputazione. Tuttavia, rischia entrambi per aiutare una stella d'azione in declino, che è anche il suo amore del college, dopo che lui è accusato di aver ucciso la sua ex-moglie.

programme.title: Ora Puoi Uccidere la Sposa
programme.desc: Nicole e Mark si fidanzano, ma la sorellastra di lui crede di avere un diritto su di lui ed è disposta a fare qualsiasi cosa per essere la sua sposa.

programme.title: Nanny's Killer Scandal
programme.desc: Con una laurea a Dartmouth, Jamie Kassman è pronta ad affrontare il mondo reale! Solo che non riesce a trovare nessuno che la assuma senza alcuna esperienza nel mondo degli affari. Accetta temporaneamente un lavoro come tata per nientemeno che il suo idolo: il carismatico multimilionario Walter Page. Le cose iniziano alla grande e Warren le fa addirittura da mentore. Ma quando lui tenta di baciarla e lei rifiuta le sue avances, le attenzioni passano rapidamente da inappropriate a mortali...

programme.title: Un amore di pescatore
programme.desc: Quando Kendall, una designer di ristoranti di successo, torna a Mystic Bay per il festival annuale del Grande Bottino, si ritrova in acque inesplorate con il nuovo arrivato in città, Zack. Kendall è in trappola per guai nella sua città natale o troverà il vero amore?

programme.title: Una bugia per amore
programme.desc: Innamorato di una donna ebrea, un uomo decide di fingersi un membro della comunità ebraica allo scopo di conquistarla.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Kim, da vero maschiaccio, è stata una campionessa di skateboard ma ha dovuto abbandonare i suoi sogni di gloria per trovare lavoro presso un fast food e mantenere se stessa e il padre.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artista trova improvvisamente la sua vita sconvolta quando la sua mostra d'arte viene cancellata e la sua fidanzata modella lo abbandona. Costretto a trasferirsi in un palazzo fatiscente, incontra pazzoidi, una donna di mezza, una prostituta matta e un dongiovanni spagnolo.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: Ti amo presidente
programme.desc: Due colleghi decidono di incontrarsi fuori dal prestigioso studio legale in cui lavorano. Lei, Michelle, è il supervisore di lui, l'affascinate Barack. L'incontro ha tutta l'aria di essere un primo appuntamento nonostante la reticenza di Michelle. Da quel giorno il mondo non è stato più lo stesso.

programme.title: Jobs
programme.desc: Interpretato da Ashton Kutcher nel ruolo del co-fondatore di Apple Steve Jobs, il film racconta la vita del giovane, brillante e appassionato imprenditore, la cui genialità ha dato il via alla rivoluzione digitale che ha cambiato per sempre il nostro modo di vivere e comunicare.

programme.title: Josie
programme.desc: Hank gestisce un motel in una tranquilla città del Sud. La sua vita solitaria viene sconvolta dall'arrivo di Josie, una studentessa del liceo bionda e sensuale, con cui stringe amicizia. Ma quando il passato della ragazza viene alla luce, si manifestano anche le sue reali intenzioni.

programme.title: Drag me to hell
programme.desc: Dopo aver affrontato una scelta difficile sul lavoro, Christine viene perseguitata da un'anziana signora che, per vendicarsi, le lancerà contro una potente maledizionei, trasformando la sua vita in un vero inferno.

programme.title: In fuga per la libertà
programme.desc: Una coppia lascia Budapest a causa del regime, ma è costretta ad abbandonare Suzanne, la figlia minore. Anni dopo, la ragazza si riunisce alla famiglia, ma fatica ad adattarsi negli Stati Uniti. Solo un viaggio in Ungheria le farà riscoprire il vero significato di libertà e casa.

programme.title: Come ti organizzo il Natale
programme.desc: Conosciuto come un "risollevatore" per clienti difficili, un talentuoso organizzatore di feste deve aiutare un giovane amministratore delegato a organizzare la festa di Natale dell'anno per stupire il sindaco e salvare la sua azienda. Il "fixer" risolverà qualcosa di più della semplice azienda?

programme.title: Sposami a Natale
programme.desc: Durante i preparativi per una cerimonia natalizia molto importante e sofisticata, Madaline Krug, un'organizzatrice di matrimoni, si innamora inaspettatamente del fratello della sposa.

programme.title: La perla del paradiso
programme.desc: Una fotografa naturalista in cerca di avventure e un timoroso scrittore di romanzi si ritrovano alle Fiji, coinvolti in una caccia ad una rara perla blu.

programme.title: Amore tra le vigne
programme.desc: Quando la scrittrice della rivista di Seattle Samantha Hart viene mandata a casa per scrivere un articolo sul matrimonio destinazione Hawthorne Vineyards, scopre che l'ex che le ha spezzato il cuore non solo gestisce il vigneto, ma sta per sposarsi lì.

programme.title: Latelier dei miei sogni
programme.desc: La stilista Skye si sposta con un "camion della moda"ma non può guidare il camion e gestire l'attività da sola. L'aiuto arriva sotto forma de Kevin. Mentre lavorano insieme, Skye e Kevin scoprono di avere più cose in comune di quanto pensassero...
